name: email-sending-template
description: Send a fixed transactional email securely with the Cloudflare Email Service binding.

FROM_ADDRESS.description: The sender address. Its domain must be onboarded to Cloudflare Email Service.

TO_ADDRESS.description: The fixed recipient address for this starter.

SEND_EMAIL_AUTH_TOKEN.description: A strong bearer token that protects the send endpoint. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.
